title: Finite projective lisse covers refine to finite-free covers
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l and n≥0, and let A be the lifted coefficient ring O_E/(ϖ_E^(n+1)) [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let S be a scheme and L a sheaf of A-modules on S_et. Suppose an etale covering {U_i→S} is given such that each pullback of L to U_i is isomorphic to the constant sheaf [def-sf-finite-free-hom-evaluation-coordinates] with value a finite projective A-module V_i. Then on the same covering each pullback of L is isomorphic to the constant sheaf with value A^(t_i) for some t_i≥0.

source.place: Paragraphs 2–3, lisse degree-zero specialization of the site-perfect stratum argument

proof.text: The valuation ring O_E is a local ring [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-integers-dvr]; A is a quotient of it, hence local or zero. A finite projective module over A is flat [lem-weil-pbc-projective-module-flat], and a finite flat module over a local ring is free [lem-weil-pbc-finite-flat-local-free]; over the zero ring every module is free. A finite basis gives V_i≅A^(t_i).

source.place: Paragraphs 2–3, lisse degree-zero specialization of the site-perfect stratum argument

proof.text: Apply the constant-sheaf functor to V_i≅A^(t_i) and compose with the given isomorphism on U_i; the covering is unchanged, and t_i=0 is allowed.
